ns2:course.label: Medical Terms-GRK & LAT Roots
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the study of the Greek and Latin roots of contemporary medical terminology and to the linguistic patterns governing their combination and usage.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is offered exclusively online with weekly assignments, but no required class time. It can also be taken through Illinois Courses Online (ICON) in a self-paced format.
